title: Blood handling and leukocyte isolation methods impact the global transcriptome of immune cells
description: In order to characterize the effects of upstream sample handling on the transcriptome of isolated leukocyte populations, we simulated various sample handling methods on whole blood prior to leukocyte isolation for low-input RNA-sequencing.
